title: 第十一章 秘境遇故人第十二章 在做突破
slug: 震惊我的徒弟居然是女帝
content_zh:
她一剑划破妖兽肚皮，发现里面是一张藏宝图。
从气息和表面上的纹路来看是有些年头的，不像是假的。
思考一番后她决定去查看一下。
顺着藏宝图的指引，她一路来到了天魔宫。
看着这个名字她似乎有些熟悉。
应该是以前见过的某个势力，但是具体是哪个她想不起来。
当她踏进魔宫的时候，就感觉有些不对劲。
仿佛无形之中有双眼睛在注视着她。
但是她对自己的实力有信心，所以她也不惧。
修行资源才是最重要，有了更多的资源，她就能早日重回巅峰。
她可不想日后被仇家发现后，自己只能等死还连累师傅。
前方是一个长长的甬道，甬道之中黑气环绕。
显得有些阴森，安妙菱小心翼翼的继续前行。
突然她感觉到魔宫深处似乎有她需要的东西。
在甬道中她杀了一些魔气幻化的魔物。
最终她来到主殿门口。
她能感觉到，自己要的东西就在里面。
推开门。
走进了大殿，殿中空无一人。
只有中间有一个玉盒，玉盒是开着的，上面有一颗天凤圣果。

就是这个东西让她的冰凤血脉产生了呼应。
天凤圣果，是帝阶下品的灵果。
一般的修者吃了后，犹如涅槃重生一样，可以增加资质，提升实力。
她吃了后，作用更大。
因为她是冰凤血脉，同源。
虽然好东西就在眼前，但是她也没有放松警惕，一步步的前进。
就当安妙菱即将触碰到圣果时，突然感觉到脚下有异动。
于是她迅速离开之前的位置。
而就在她离开的那一瞬间，地上出现一个困阵。
困阵之上一个灵魂体，逐渐显现。
竟然是圣魄！
安妙菱神色凝重了起来，圣魄就是圣境强者的魂魄。
当圣魄形态的穆以寒看清楚安妙菱的长相时。
脸色变的狰狞了起来。
当年就是这张脸的主人，屠杀了她天魔宫不少强者，才导致她天魔宫落魄至此。
那一次也还好她不在宗内，不然她也难以幸免。
“绝情女帝你该死。”穆以寒一脸愤怒的吼道。
安妙菱眉头一蹙，竟然是认识自己的人。
因为重生后的她相貌和上一世几乎是一样的。
“你是谁？”安妙菱反问。

“不知道你还记得天魔宫吗？”
content_en:
She slashed the monster's belly with her sword and found a treasure map inside.
Judging from the smell and the texture on the surface, it seems to be old, and it doesn't look like it's fake.
After some thought she decided to check it out.
Following the guidance of the treasure map, she came all the way to the Demon Palace.
The name seemed familiar to her.
It should be some force that she had seen before, but she couldn't remember which one it was.
When she stepped into the Demon Palace, she felt something was wrong.
It was as if there were invisible eyes watching her.
But she has confidence in her own strength, so she is not afraid.
Cultivation resources are the most important thing. With more resources, she can return to the top as soon as possible.
She didn't want to be found out by her enemies in the future, and she would have to wait for death and implicate her master.
Ahead is a long corridor surrounded by black energy.
Looking a little eerie, An Miaoling continued to move forward cautiously.
Suddenly she felt that there seemed to be something she needed deep in the Demon Palace.
In the corridor, she killed some monsters transformed by evil energy.
Finally she arrived at the door of the main hall.
She could feel that what she wanted was inside.
Push the door open.
Entering the main hall, there was no one in the hall.
There is only a jade box in the middle. The jade box is open and there is a Tianfeng Sacred Fruit on it.
It was this thing that made her Ice Phoenix bloodline respond.
Tianfeng Sacred Fruit is a low-grade spiritual fruit of the imperial rank.
After eating it, ordinary cultivators feel like they are reborn in Nirvana, and can increase their qualifications and improve their strength.
After she took it, the effect was even greater.
Because she is of Ice Phoenix bloodline, from the same origin.
Although good things were right in front of her, she did not relax her vigilance and moved forward step by step.
Just when An Miaoling was about to touch the holy fruit, she suddenly felt something strange moving under her feet.
So she quickly left her previous position.
And the moment she left, a trap appeared on the ground.
A soul body above the trap gradually appeared.
It turned out to be the Holy Spirit!
An Miaoling's expression became solemn, the holy soul was the soul of a strong person in the holy realm.
When Mu Yihan, who was in the form of a holy soul, saw An Miaoling's appearance clearly.
His expression turned ferocious.
It was the owner of this face who massacred many powerful people in her Heavenly Demon Palace, which caused her Heavenly Demon Palace to fall into this state.
Fortunately she was not in the sect that time, otherwise she would not have been spared.
"You deserve to die, the ruthless empress." Mu Yihan shouted angrily.
An Miaoling frowned, it turned out to be someone who knew her.
Because her appearance after rebirth is almost the same as in her previous life.
"Who are you?" An Miaoling asked.
"I wonder if you still remember the Demon Palace?"
